text:
Make an agent invocation's stop reason and record show a login-expiry retry and the invocation's real deadline. Read: in job 20261113-112836-b7sx the producer record has caps.timeout_s 5400 and a measured wall time of about 5406 s, yet its detail and the job's outcome say "deadline of 616s reached". retry_spec in crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs (about line 381) gives the retry what is left of the timeout, and deadline_reason prints the retry's own timeout. 616 + 4784 = 5400, so the first call probably ran about 4784 s before its login expired. This is inferred: the record does not say a retry happened. The person running Athena read it as a 616 s deadline ignored for 80 minutes (intervention 20261113-132803-knm6). Introspection 20261113-132810-w407 then proposed an outside watchdog, and failure class ze7x was opened on that premise. Fix: (1) When the second call of a merged invocation ends at its deadline, name the invocation's full deadline in the reason, say that a retry after an expired login started at N s, and give the time left. (2) Store in the invocation record that a retry happened, when it started, and the first call's wall time and cost. (3) Show the same text in the job's outcome and progress note. Tests: use a stand-in agent whose first call ends with the expired-login signal and whose retry runs past its share. Assert that the reason names the full timeout and the retry, and that the record holds both calls. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry. Do not build a separate watchdog: the measured wall time shows the deadline held. Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and the full cargo test.

Acceptance:
- The change is made as described: After a login-expiry retry, a producer's stop reason gives the retry's leftover time as its deadline (616 s on a 5400 s cap), and the intervention and introspection then blamed an unenforced deadline
- No unrelated behavior changes; the existing tests pass
- fmt, clippy and test pass

Files: crates/athena-agent/src/claude.rs, CHANGELOG.md
